name: lodestar
description: Lodestar — your compass for life: capture every open question, prioritize what matters, and never lose one. SQLite-backed so nothing is lost.

scripts.test-brain: BOARD_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3001 BRAIN_CHROMA_URL=http://localhost:8004 BRAIN_CHROMA_DATABASE=lodestar-test BRAIN_CHECKPOINT_DB=databases/test/brain-checkpoints-3001.db uv run --project brain --extra local-embeddings uvicorn lodestar_brain.server:app --port 9001
scripts.test:all: node scripts/backup-db.mjs && node --test tests/*.test.js && uv run --project brain pytest brain/tests -v && uv run --with playwright python tests/e2e_test.py
scripts.eval-live: BRAIN_EVAL_LIVE=1 BRAIN_LLM=claude-cli uv run --project brain pytest brain/tests/evals -m live -v
